entries.subject: Implemented most of the base parser.
Add Decode() method to Value to DRY.
Require cmd:"" or arg:"" for branching commands/args.
Use variadic options to configure Kong.
Allow parent flags to be processed #4
Factor parsing out into a ParseContext type.
Factor out duplicate value reset code.
Move ParseContext into its own file.
README fix for the kong tag change
Use new Tag type for slice separator.
A basic refactor in build, splitting the two main code branches.
Remove a bunch of duplicate recover code.
Separate validation into a distinct step.
Allow "bare" tags and moved tag tests into tag_test.go. Fixes #19
Added tag test for multiple separators.
Add some helper functions to the models.
Fix display of default value in placeholder.
Don't apply Options twice. This is less confusing.
Add <command> to help when a sub-command is required.
Add a default-enabled EnvResolver for the env tag.
Add configuration loading + docs + linter fixes.
Rename Value.Value to Value.Target to correctly reflect its purpose.
Track trace values externally to the path.
Move separator defaulting back into Tag.
Better error reporting for short flags.
Compact help should display full command.
Add path, existingfile and existingdir types.
Ensure -- consumes all tokens, not just positional.
Clean up disparity between Context and Kong.
Add support for a mapper interface directly on fields.
Convert Option to an interface and make Vars a map conforming to the interface.
Add contextual information to mapper errors.
Support multiple key+value pairs for map flags.
Use a dynamically sized left column in help.
Fix incorrect error missing for missing required args.
Add ConfigFlag for loading configuration through a flag.
Allow bool flags to be set to true or false explicitly.
Add BindTo option for binding interface implementations.
Add support for setting variables via tag.
Add Visitor function for walking the model.
Treat envars as higher priority than resolvers.
Convert resolvers to an interface with a Validate() method.
Add a FileContentFlag that loads the contents of a file into a flag
Make FileContentFlag a struct to keep track of the path.
Support for adding bindings to the Context.
Ensure context bindings are used for Run().
Clean up error handling a bit.
Don't show ... in help for named slice types.
Ensure flag defaults (or envars) aren't scanned in as untyped tokens.
Hide sub-tree when parent is hidden.
A few extra fixes and tests.
Allow multiple Vars{} to be passed.
Call Run(...) for all parent nodes.
fix: `hidden` tag is not passed to the flag object
feat: add a command tree help view (#32)
Factor out command help into functions.
Make invalid value error messages more useful.
Use interface{} instead of string in tokens.
ApplyDefaults() now only applies defaults if the value is not already otherwise set.
Make most option functions return Option rather than OptionFunc.
Print error after usage when UsageOnError is set.
Remove unused return value from PopValueInto.
Produce a more useful error when flag-like values are used for flag values.
Quote enum values when displaying errors.
A note in the README linking to a JSON example.
Support for default values ${var=default} in interpolation variables.
Much more thorough checking of enum values.
Bind parent nodes when executing Run().
Use more recent version of go.
Don't validate enum values for unused required paths.
Test and docs for TextUnmarshaler and json.Unmarshaler.
Don't select default command when displaying help.
Add README + go modules to server example.
add support to make map separator configurable
Fix panic when "-" is not followed by a short flag.
Allow binds to be provided by a function.
Convert env management to a resolver.
Allow "-" as a positional or flag argument.
Update README with note about existingfile and `-`.
Revert "Convert env management to a resolver."
Fix integer overlows in tests on 32-bit systems.
factor CloneWith out of most interpolate cases
Added -h as default short parameter for the automatic --help flag.
Fix help tests with the introduction of -h
Format help placeholders with slice/map separators
Add GetSep to simplify Tag initialisation
Correctly return errors when configuration parsing fails.
When using resolvers, use last value only.
Fix enum's from envars not validating (fixes #107).
More useful error message when finding an unexpected struct.
Do not run parent node on missing child err with usageOnMissing option
Call Validate() functions on nodes if present.
Ensure values aren't nil before decoding.
Fully describe how help is generated.
Add support for groups in the default HelpPrinter (#135)
Support a simplified `kong.Groups{<key>: <title>}` way of specifiying groups.
Add a bit of extra spacing if group description is provided.
Help Option to position flags in help output
Add aliases to tree help output
Add support for negated boolean flags
Add `negatable` tag to set a bool to be negatable.
Add test case for inverting the negation
Add negatable output when using short flag names
Allow `-` for stdout in path mapper (#147)
Add option to not expand subcommand help
Display multiple optional args in a more expected way.
Add support for dynamically registered commands.
tag: add passthrough for positional arguments
fix panic resolver's configuration file does not have read permission
Add some details to the ignore field example
Fixes #125: Support custom per-mapper placeholder text (#169)
Fix issue with negatable flag being negated twice (#171)
Validate short flags are a single rune.
Add an option to clamp the help wrap width
Don't fail on required positional arguments that have envars.
Allow multiple xor:"" groups to be defined.
Enum fields must be required or have a default.
Added sub objects support in JSON resolver (#178)
Allow DynamicCommand to specify arbitrary tags.
Add aliases to ALL help output (#191)
Support duration as nanosecond number when using a resolver
Add ability to ignore fields that match given regex pattern(s) (#199)
[#88] Use reflect-compatible struct tags in examples (#202)
Update Help.go to make Sub Commands can be  Hidden (#207)
Allow Mappers to contribute Vars to interpolation.
Allow root application to have a Run(...) error method.
Only prepend EnvPrefix if .Env is not empty.
Add help testcase for envprefix + no env.
feat: add support for variable interpolation into env tag key (#234)
Use reflect-compatible struct tags in examples
Fix that default should not override the placeholder.
Support $$ for escaping $ in interpolated values.
Do not add environment variable to help it is already present.
Allow more flexible callback return error type.
fix: overly enthusiastic validation of tags
Differentiate between omitted and empty default.
Add ChangeToFlag to allow changing the current working directory.
Cmd can be passthrough now, too.
fix: issue with symlinked temp dirs
